title: The Periodic Table of Elements
text: The periodic table organizes all known chemical elements in a tabular arrangement by atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties. Dmitri Mendeleev published the first widely recognized version of the periodic table in 1869, organizing elements by atomic mass and predicting the existence of then-undiscovered elements. The table has 118 confirmed elements, 94 of which occur naturally. Elements are arranged in periods (horizontal rows) and groups (vertical columns); elements in the same group share chemical properties. The noble gases (Group 18) are chemically inert. The lanthanides and actinides are typically shown as separate rows at the bottom of the table.
